title: Rav Tachlifa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Moed Katan 25a](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.25a.9), he says, “I saw Rav Huna about to sit on his bed,” etc. In [Menachot 32b](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.32b.6), Rav Chelbo gives the account. Hyman reports the same reading in Sefer Yuchasin and Dikdukei Soferim.
We find at [Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 2:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Shabbat.2.1.9): Rabbi Tachlifa asked Rav Chisda, “Did you not, Master, teach us thus?” etc.
In [Avodah Zarah 15a](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.15a.1), Rav Tachlifa cites Rav Shila bar Avimi (or Avina), who speaks in Rav’s name.
In [Jerusalem Talmud Peah 4:7](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Peah.4.7.3): a dispute of Rav Kahana and Rabbi Tachlifa.[^1]

notes.text: Moed Katan gives Tachlifa and Menachot gives Chelbo for the account of Rav Huna. The consulted Peah calls him Rav Tachlifa where Hyman has the abbreviated title, rendered “Rabbi” here.
